item.text:
### (a) Social posts

1. We mean this literally: if anyone builds superintelligence with anything like current techniques, everyone on Earth will die. No company, government, or laboratory has the right to take that risk. We need a legally binding prohibition.

2. We cannot control systems we do not understand. Building superintelligence with current techniques would not be innovation; it would be the end of humanity. We demand an internationally enforced ban before anyone builds it.

3. We reject the race to superintelligence. There is no prize worth human extinction, no competitive advantage worth everyone dying. We choose survival. Governments must prohibit the development of superintelligence now.

### (b) Newsletter opening — 120 words

We need to say this without euphemism: if anyone builds superintelligence using anything like today’s techniques, everyone on Earth will die. Current AI systems are not understood well enough to control, and scaling them toward capabilities beyond every human mind would not solve that problem; it would make the consequences irreversible. No company, government, or laboratory has the right to impose that risk on humanity. Voluntary promises, safety teams, and racing regulations are not enough. We need a legally binding, internationally enforced prohibition on developing superintelligence, backed by verification and penalties. The stakes are not market share or geopolitical advantage. They are whether humanity has a future. We choose survival, and we call on every government to do the same.
